Supporting Cast Pair for 'Shin Oishinbo' Announced
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Tetsu Kariya's Oishinbo manga, titled Shin Oishinbo, announced a supporting pair of cast on Thursday. The anime is scheduled to premiere in 2027. Voice actors Kenji Yamauchi (Toujima Tanzaburou wa Kamen Rider ni Naritai) and Ken Uo (Nazotoki wa Dinner no Ato de) are joining the anime as Mantarou Kyougoku and Toujin Touyama, respectively. 'Nabe ni Tama wo Ukenagara' Reveals Main Cast, Staff, Teaser Promo, Winter 2027 Premiere
Production company Asmik Ace opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Juntarou Aoki and Shin Moriyama's Nabe ni Tama wo Ukenagara (Getting Shots on Frying Pan) manga on Thursday, revealing the main cast, staff, and a teaser promotional video. Produced by J.C.Staff, the anime is scheduled to premiere on Nippon TV, Yomiuri TV, BS Nippon TV, and AT-X in January 2027.
